notes.title: A major update, “Demon World Edition,” is now available!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience!
The update will add content to the Demon World Edition! 
Enjoy fishing in the Demon World!

The Demon World section will be the content after the normal end is reached.
Players who have already reached the normal end of the game will start the event when they start the game after updating.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/c19310fd6beef34fc7e558e913ff8db076c1fb02.png"]

Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improvements:

Changed SE when fishing with Frog Rod
Adjust callout font
Adjusted the difficulty level of the dungeon part
Upgraded the effect of the Venom Rod 

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug when skipping some events
Fixed a display bug with crafts
Fixed a display bug in the end roll

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835110/Sea_Fantasy/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Version 1.4.30 Update
notes.content:
Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improvements:

We've made major improvements to the processing load!

In line with the improvements to the processing load,
we've reduced the number of pages for the Material Box and Fish Hook Box,
which had excessive space.

- Material Box: 12 → 10
- Fish Hook Box: 15 → 4

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused objects to remain when skipping certain events
Fixed layer corruption on some maps

notes.title: Retranslation Complete! - Version 1.4.25 Update
notes.content:
In-game text has been retranslated! 

Thank you for your patience.
We have requested a translation company to re-translate the in-game text that we previously announced, and it has been completed!

The following languages have been re-translated.

・English
・Korean
・Simplified Chinese
・Traditional Chinese

If there are still unnatural translation parts, please let us know on Discord or the community hub.

notes.title: About Translation - Version 1.4.22 Update
notes.content:
In-game translations

As previously announced in the news,
we are currently retranslating the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2835110/view/499436070246548213?l=english

The retranslation is currently well underway by an excellent translation company!
It is expected to be completed on February 10, 2025.

An update reflecting the retranslation will be available on or about February 12, 2025!

 Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improvements:

The dash and cancel key bindings for keyboard operations have been separated.

By default, they are assigned to the following

Dash: Left Shit key
Cancel: Z key

※You can assign the key bindings to any key you like from the settings screen.

The following other improvements have been made


Improved UI for keyboard operation
Enhanced warning display for reset events.
Resumed from before the boss battle when the boss battle is killed in the dungeon part
Adjusted the maximum movement speed in the control panel to twice the speed of the previous version.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a problem with abnormal acceleration on icy floors when movement speed is increased.
Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: Add Event - Version 1.4.19 Update
notes.content:
An event has been added to Edo! 

An event has been added to the large mansion at the back of Edo!
The event will proceed when you talk to the character in the mansion!
*There are specific conditions for the event to occur. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/20b27a0c4f124a28109842f0eb20603e5e12e8c8.jpg

 Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improvements:

Added indication of whether or not crown size fishing is available when using the “SeaAZ Detector”.
Added the ability to select a save slot when saving from the play screen.
The number of items purchased is now displayed on the store screen.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where material information would not be displayed when crafting fish hooks.
Fixed layer break issues on some maps
Fixed other minor bugs

notes.title: Added Marie's Island event & About Translation - Version 1.4.15 Update
notes.content:
Added event for Marie's Island! 

By approaching the house on Marie's Island,
the interact option will be displayed!

Please check the event content in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/466eae256c5afe3f75a18eab5cfb5cc6c457d440.jpg

 In-game translations

As previously announced in the news,
we are currently retranslating the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2835110/view/499436070246548213?l=english

We believe that the UI translations in particular are insufficient.
(SeaAZ descriptions, item descriptions, etc.)

We are prioritizing these translations first.

We have requested a translation company to re-translate the text, and we are currently working on this.
We are working to update the text as quickly as possible, so please wait a little longer.


 Improvements and Bug Fixes

Improvements:

Reduced processing load

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where no animation was shown when acquiring rare materials
Fixed layer break issues on some maps
Fixed other minor bugs

notes.content:
Thank you for playing Sea Fantasy!
We’ve made the following improvements and bug fixes:

Improvements


HP will now fully recover when retrying boss battles.
Increased the selling price of some materials.
Reduced the stats of some SeaAZ.
Made the numbers on the fishing hook crafting UI visible.
Adjusted the volume of some SE and BGM.


不具合修正

notes.title: Release date & price announced!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is the Sea Fantasy development team!

We have officially announced the release date and price of Sea Fantasy today!

Release Date
January 7th, 2025 at 12:00AM (PST)

Price
$14.99

The game has a volume that can be completed in about 10 hours!
With side events and more, you can enjoy up to 20 hours of gameplay!

Please add it to your wishlist and look forward to the release date!

Follow us on Twitter (X) and Discord to stay updated with the latest news!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/92f9c5c7089aff31e01b48e158129df79cfa4666.gif

notes.title: The final beta test has started!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is the Sea Fantasy development team.

The final beta test will be available during the following period!

November 14, 2024(JST) - November 30, 2024(JST)

Players who participate and complete the beta will have their names featured in the end credits of the product version!

We look forward to your participation and feedback! 🙇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/0f86c7751f45c845429b2e1a1f724e70e80439a1.jpg

For those who have already played and completed the demo version

If you have already played and completed the demo version,
and wish to be listed in the end credits, there is no need to start from the beginning!

You can continue playing the game and speak to Bacchus, who is located at the coast of "The paddock" to play the submarine game again.

By completing the submarine game, the form for end credits listing will appear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/d070ec7f81f5f711ee45d16555a8959c0b5d3c2f.jpg

notes.title: Thanks for trying out the demo version!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is the Sea Fantasy development team.

The demo version that was released in conjunction with the June edition of the Steam Next festival has now been played by over 10,000 people!

Thank you to everyone who has played it!
And thank you for all the feedback!

We have about 7 months left until the release of the full version, and our development team is working hard to make it the best experience possible.

Please look forward to it!

Upcoming Events

We will be exhibiting at offline events and other events until the full version is released!
We can't disclose what events we will be exhibiting at yet, but we will be offering exclusive Sea Fantasy merchandise for visitors.

We will announce on the Steam Community Hub and official Twitter(X)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897249/14e90e12bd473ac9f681c09253430c0ee25790b5.png

Release period of the demo version

The demo version was scheduled to be made private with the end of the June edition of the Steam Next festival, but due to its popularity, it will remain public for a while!

We will let you know when we will make it private.
